long_biography.plain_text:
Nuntius combined Theofanis Moraitakis's academic training with a regulated securities business. He had taught financial management at Athens University of Economics and Business before entering the brokerage's share capital. As one of two near-equal family shareholders, he became general manager and worked alongside his brother Alexandros.

During Moraitakis's tenure, Nuntius moved beyond Greece through branches and cross-border investment services in several European markets. Company accounts documented his substantial stake and shareholder remuneration, while capital-market records confirmed his professional certification. The expansion took the company into markets including Spain and Romania.
